boundary: Small self-contained workload pairs, not whole applications. Same Deno/V8 Wasm engine. Native Rust is not measured. Fresh compiler processes with warm filesystem caches; Rust links its prebuilt standard library, Blot checks imported source. Compile times include codegen/linking, exclude wrapper startup. Runtime includes generated input/allocation/computation/destruction, scalar Wasm calls and required Blot ownership hooks, excludes module compile/instantiate and correctness witnesses. Rust iterators may fuse intermediate collections. ASCII text uses each language's native representation. No third-party libraries or I/O.
